whyme.text: I'm Ish-ee-tah Suh-mah-dee-yah, E E C S and Business at Berkeley M E T I like finding messy product problems, figuring out what actually matters, and building the system that fixes them.

proof.text: At MIT C-sail, evaluation design for rag in production. At FrontDesk, a customer problem taken from interviews to a shipped pipeline. At Vay-len-see, benchmarking on bootstrap intervals. And Holographic Studio: an idea that already worked, plus its missing layer.

hook.text: Here's one. Three weeks after go-live, Con-toe-so's claim agent approved this claim for zero dollars. The eval said ninety-four percent, green. Both are true. If I joined Team Delta tomorrow, this is what I'd fix first.

works.text: Delta's forward-deployed engineers embed with the customer. Every engagement starts with an expert-graded golden set, replayed on every release. C I for agents.

signal.text: Then the customer's analysts start overriding one decision in four. The eval never moves.

hypothesis.text: So instead of asking if the agent is right: how much of this week's traffic has the eval actually seen?

measure.text: Embed every claim, calibrate on the golden set itself, measure. Fifty-four percent.

move1.text: Move one: find what the eval has never seen. Uncovered claims cluster by content and name themselves: a new portal export, a promo type from after discovery, co-op claims with no invoice.

move2.text: Move two: grade ten, not a thousand. Typical claims, random draws, and the cases the judge was unsure about. Judge agreement is measured per blind spot: not validated here, not trusted here.

move3.text: Move three: block the release. Coverage above eighty-five, no blind spot below eighty, no regression outside a bootstrap interval. One command, one exit code, straight into C I.

stack.text: TypeScript end to end: React, Node and sequel-lite with checkpointed jobs, REST plus live events, tested math, optional Azure OpenAI.

harvest.text: After: thirty cases graded in an afternoon. Golden set vee two.

blocked.text: Release one-three on vee two: eighty-seven point nine, zero on the portal cluster. Blocked, reason named.

fixed.text: A fourteen-line parser patch. Release one-four: ninety-four, plus six points, interval above zero, coverage above ninety. Pass.

control.text: A control: the next release moves one point, the interval includes zero, the gate stays green. No crying wolf.

close.text: We don't ship agents we can't measure. Blindspot keeps the measurement about this week. I'd love to build the next one with Team Delta.
